title: Тёплая классика
prompt: Create a clear VISUAL PROTOTYPE BOARD for a mobile political-career game in Godot 3D. Exactly TWO equal tall portrait screenshots side by side with a thin cream divider, each approximately 393:852 in proportion. LEFT is an early clerk's shared workspace (РЕФЕРЕНТ), RIGHT is a late party leader's office (ПЕРВЫЙ АРХОНТ). Small readable Russian labels along the bottom outside the scene. The actual prototype game screenshot is reference 1 for achievable 3D simplicity; reference 2 is the friend's game for warm palette, intimate comfortable composition, wood detailing and soft lighting. This must look like attainable clean stylized real-time 3D using simple meshes and painted materials, not a photoreal offline architectural visualization. NO characters. IMPORTANT: exactly ONE large closed wooden interactive door in EACH panel, centered at 60 percent of panel width and 43 percent of scene height, occupying about 23 percent of panel width and 32 percent of scene height. Door in exactly the same screen position and same apparent size in both early and late panel; do not shrink late door or hide behind desk props. This door is on the INNER corridor wall, no city outside it. LEFT EARLY panel has NO WINDOW anywhere, modest cubicle/shared office furnishings in warm cream, muted teal and honey wood, shared workstations hinted at sides. RIGHT LATE panel has exactly ONE architectural L-SHAPED CORNER WINDOW on the LEFT exterior side of the room, with glazing meeting around a real visible exterior building corner, positioned separate from the corridor door; no arbitrary window beside door on same flat wall. Through it a restrained simplified American skyline with a stately white capitol dome and one art-deco tower. Window only appears from Archon stage onward. Late office feels larger through side seating zone, richer panelling, refined ceiling light and floor treatment, not camera pulling away. Preserve door and desk size. Cream compact header placeholders and a slim burgundy bottom action bar, no need for readable game statistics. Warm inviting lighting, legible shapes, coherent materials, restrained detail. DESIGN A: calm classic American civic office. Frontal corridor wall with visible large door and warm framed panels. Early: practical shared clerk station, aged honey oak, teal fabric divider, modest pendant. Late: dark walnut panelled office with forest-green walls, brass wall sconces, tall bookcase at far right and a small armchair group at left. A narrow left side-wall L-shaped glazed bay, believable floor plan. Strongest priority: readable stable door and cozy compact desk; efficient simple geometry.
